The document contains POS metadata including Cashier ID (0975), Shop number (813), receipt/order number (2478), Till number (4), and a timestamp (16/08/18, 18:12). A refund deadline notice is printed along with detailed exchange and refund policy statements, followed by a thank-you message and a machine-readable barcode with numeric code at the bottom. The receipt format reflects a fashion apparel retail POS system used in international clothing stores.
